statement: Fix an integer Q ≥ 1 and κ > 0. In the normal-cylinder setting above, scale a physical base radius l to one and suppose B4 is available. Set τ = |M| + D + Λ. If τ(B4) ≤ d = e−T , l + sup |zphys| ≤ dκ , (3.10) where the supremum is over the restricted support above the available chart, then, for T sufficiently large, Z w d(2M − D − CQΛ) ≤ d exp[−FQ(T)] (3.11) whenever w is supported in B1, 0 ≤ w ≤ 1, and Lip w ≤ 1. The finite derivative order J, threshold, and constants depend only on the stated fixed data. For a subchart in inherited frames, the second condition is imposed on γ in Equation (3.5). For a flat reference, take Λ = 0 and omit the second condition.
